label: Current is consumed
correctPrinciple: In a steady series circuit, the same current flows through every component; energy is transferred, not current consumed.
remediationHint: Compare charge passing two points in the same series loop each second.

label: Every series component gets source voltage
correctPrinciple: Potential differences across series components add to the source voltage.
remediationHint: Add the component voltage drops and compare them with the battery voltage.

label: Longer wire means more current
correctPrinciple: For a uniform wire R = rho L/A; at fixed voltage, current decreases as resistance increases.
remediationHint: Hold material and area fixed, then use both R = rho L/A and I = V/R.

label: Incidence angle measured from the surface
correctPrinciple: Angles of incidence and reflection are measured from the normal.
remediationHint: Draw a perpendicular to the mirror before measuring the angle.

label: Plane mirror image is projectable
correctPrinciple: A plane mirror forms a virtual image; reflected rays do not actually converge behind the mirror.
remediationHint: Distinguish actual ray intersections from backward extensions.

label: Light entering glass bends away
correctPrinciple: For oblique incidence from air into glass, light slows and bends toward the normal.
remediationHint: Compare speed in air and glass, then locate the normal.

label: Distances used without signs
correctPrinciple: Use the Cartesian sign convention consistently when applying mirror or lens equations.
remediationHint: Mark the optical centre or pole and the positive direction before substituting distances.

label: Power rating equals energy consumed
correctPrinciple: Power is the rate of energy transfer; energy equals power multiplied by time.
remediationHint: Write units for power and time, then calculate E = Pt.

label: Short circuit and overload are identical
correctPrinciple: An overload is excessive current from demand; a short circuit is an unintended low-resistance path.
remediationHint: Identify whether too many appliances or direct live-neutral contact caused the current.

label: Myopia needs a convex lens
correctPrinciple: Myopia is corrected using a concave lens, which diverges incoming rays.
remediationHint: Locate the uncorrected distant image relative to the retina.

label: Sky colour independent of wavelength
correctPrinciple: Small atmospheric particles scatter shorter visible wavelengths more strongly than longer wavelengths.
remediationHint: Compare scattering of blue and red light.

label: A solar cell stores energy
correctPrinciple: A solar cell converts light into electrical energy; a separate storage device is needed for later use.
remediationHint: Separate the roles of a solar cell and a rechargeable battery.
